findings: Work zone identified: Swanston St east side, Grattan St to Faraday St

analysis.provenance: The impact numbers and severity come from the impact model through lib/impact. Only these progress steps are fixed.

explanations.decision: Review the on-road pedestrian walkway beside the tram tracks, and confirm Yarra Trams approval, before this setup is deployed.

actions.title: Protect the on-road pedestrian walkway
actions.summary: Southbound pedestrians walk on the road beside the tram tracks. Keep a continuous barrier between them and the tracks.
actions.impact: The footpath is closed, so southbound pedestrians walk on the road while traffic controllers hold traffic.
actions.why: The walkway runs between the work area and the tram tracks. People need a protected, wide enough path the whole way.
actions.recommendation: Run water-filled barriers the full length of the walkway, and check its clear width against the scan before deployment.

actions.title: Confirm trams can pass the works
actions.summary: Swanston St is a major tram corridor. Works on a tram road need Yarra Trams approval.
actions.impact: Barriers and the pedestrian walkway sit on the road beside the tram tracks, near the La Trobe St tram stop.
actions.why: If trams must stop or slow past the works, delays spread along the whole corridor.
actions.recommendation: Send the plan to Yarra Trams for approval, and check the barrier line keeps clear of the tram path and stop.

actions.title: Check the covered hook turn slot
actions.summary: The plan covers the hook turn slot at La Trobe St and places bollards there. Drivers used to turning from it may still try.
actions.impact: A driver who expects the hook turn can stop or swerve at the bollards, next to the works and the tram tracks.
actions.why: Unexpected stops at a busy tram junction put drivers, cyclists and the traffic controllers at risk.
actions.recommendation: Add a no hook turn sign before La Trobe St and check the bollards and cover are visible from the approach.

safety.description: Two controls need review: the on-road walkway beside the tram tracks, and the covered hook turn slot at La Trobe St.
safety.basis: Fixed demo finding from the plan and the site scan. Scan measurement is not connected yet.
